Fields.Name: Enter Event
Fields.Description: The event sent when the interval is entered. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Exit Event
Fields.Description: The event sent when the interval is left. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Enter Time
Fields.Description: When the interval opens, in seconds after the state is entered (used when there's no enter event).

Fields.Name: Exit Time
Fields.Description: When the interval closes, in seconds after the state is entered (used when there's no exit event). 0 for no end.
